description: This line plot compares the initial and final accuracy of a model across 19 different trials or configurations, with the x-axis labeled “Trial” and ranging from 1 to 19 in integer steps, and the y-axis labeled “Accuracy” ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear scale. The “Initial Accuracy” is represented by a green line with solid square markers, starting at approximately 0.33, peaking at 0.50 at trial 5, declining to 0.30 at trial 7, rising again to 0.45 at trial 13, and ending at 0.40 at trial 19. The “Final Accuracy” is represented by a blue line with solid triangle markers, starting at approximately 0.65, peaking at 0.90 at trial 9, declining to 0.70 at trial 11, rising again to 0.90 at trial 15, and ending at 0.88 at trial 19. Both lines are accompanied by error bars indicating variability, and the final accuracy consistently remains higher than the initial accuracy across all trials.
